description: Connect an AI assistant to HostTracker over MCP: run website checks from 300+ locations and manage monitors, alerts, incidents, webhooks and status pages. Client setup, tool catalogue, safety policy.
rules: Remote streamable-HTTP server at https://mcp.host-tracker.com/mcp; nothing to install.
Authenticate with Authorization: Bearer <token>, minted at https://www.host-tracker.com/integrations/api with the scopes the assistant should have.
Single-resource delete tools preview first and only delete with confirmed=true; the server never modifies the account itself (profile, email, billing).
